messages:
InfraBot: :rotating_light: alert - autoscaler reported repeated CUDA driver resets on cluster-19 (3 nodes) and 12 container restarts in the last 10m. Marking SEV2.
selena: saw repeated OOM traces and `attention_paged_alloc` warnings, memory use creeping on kv-shell layer, fragmentation counters ticking up.
mike_oncall: I'm on it, joining now. What customer-facing impact?
selena: 2 customers on Dedicated are seeing elevated 5xx rates and slow tail latencies (~600ms -> 2.4s p99 for short chat flows). No full outage yet, but errors correlate with node flaps.
ops-bot: Notified #status, creating incident incident/7400000000.ops.
selena: stack traces show `cudaDriverInit` resets and then allocator failing to reclaim paged KV slots; suspect slow leak in the kv-shell shadow map.
naveen: rolling a quick metric check: kv_shell_free_pages down from 92% -> 67% in 2 hours, fragmentation_ratio 0.48 -> 0.79. Looks like compaction isn't keeping up with small-page churn.
mike_oncall: can we force compaction on affected nodes? Is there a safe hot path?
selena: we have a compact tool but it's heavy; prefer incremental defrag first. I'll push a toggle to enable `kv.compact.incremental=true` on cluster-19 and set `evict.soft_threshold=0.65`.
selena: command: ```
# enable incremental compaction and bump soft-evict
rdctl cluster set cluster-19 kv.compact.incremental true
rdctl cluster set cluster-19 kv.evict.soft_threshold 0.65
```
mike_oncall: doing that now. ETA 90s for flags to roll.
InfraBot: deploy job started for flags on cluster-19 (job id j-7400000000-1).
amber_c: is this safe for Dedicated customers? eviction may increase token cost but avoids restarts. customers flagged for potential latency impact?
selena: yes amber — will monitor. prefer avoid node restarts while compaction runs.
mike_oncall: flags rolled. Metrics: free_pages up to 72% after first cycle, fragmentation_ratio slowly down to 0.70. Some containers still showing CUDA reset events though.
naveen: digging into driver logs — GPU watchdog triggered during large batched workloads. Possibly an unexpected kernel path combined with high fragmentation causing pages to migrate.
selena: plan B if compaction stalls: cordon one node, gracefully drain, restart driver and run offline full compaction, then uncordon. That will cause a short capacity dip.
ops-bot: paging SRE sprint team to standby, paging amber_c@pager.
amber_c: standby. If we need to cordon, prefer timebox 5m drain so customer impact minimal. Notify customer-ops.
selena: assigned runbook step: compact-run -> /runbooks/kv-shell-compaction (link: https://redwood.runbooks/internal/kv-shell-compaction). Follow the safe drain checklist.
cust-ops: FYI we're preparing a short message draft for affected customers: "We're investigating elevated errors/latency tied to GPU node restarts; mitigations in progress." Want approval to send if we cordon nodes.
mike_oncall: yes send a brief message if we cordon. For now wait until we see sustained improvement.
InfraBot: job j-7400000000-1 completed: incremental compaction cycles ran on all nodes in cluster-19.
naveen: after cycles, fragmentation_ratio at 0.61 and free_pages at 80% on two nodes, but node-7 still 58% and showing 5 recent CUDA reset events.
mike_oncall: I'll cordon node-7 now and initiate graceful drain. Expect ~120s for inflight requests to finish, then restart container runtime and run full compaction.
selena: steps: `rdctl node cordon node-7`, `rdctl node drain node-7 --grace 120`, then `rdctl node restart-runtime node-7`, then run compaction script: ```
ssh rnode7
sudo systemctl stop rd-runtime
/srv/infra/kv_compact_full.sh --max-threads 4 --force
sudo systemctl start rd-runtime
```
mike_oncall: cordoned node-7 and draining (grace 120s). Notifying #incidents and cust-ops.
cust-ops: sent customer note about potential brief interruption.
Amber_c: monitoring customer tickets — one support case already reported p99 spikes, emailing customer with update.
InfraBot: node-7 runtime restarted, compaction job started (job id j-7400000000-2).
naveen: compaction progress: 40% after 3m, memory fragmentation falling. No more CUDA resets observed since restart.
mike_oncall: compaction finished. node-7 free_pages 92%, fragmentation_ratio 0.23, back to cluster and uncordoned.
selena: cluster health returning to normal. p99 latency trending back to 450ms, error rate back to baseline.
ops-bot: marking incident as mitigated pending postmortem. Would like follow-up: root cause deeper — compaction backpressure combined with a rare kernel path on large batched attention calls.
selena: agreed, will open a follow-up ticket to audit allocator hot paths and add a canary to exercise large-batch attention flows under high fragmentation.
mike_oncall: great work team. I'll draft the incident summary and customer impact note. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: incident incident/7400000000.ops transitioning to MONITOR state.
selena: postmortem owners: selena, naveen. ETA draft EOD tomorrow.
Mike_oncall: leaving handoff to selena. If anything flares I'll rejoin.
selena: handoff: monitoring for 2h, slack pings only if fragmentation_ratio > 0.6 or CUDA resets recur.
ops-bot: closing on-call thread. :white_check_mark:
